+---

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9280'
+title: 'Gated live-model hot-reload test fails: model output is not valid JSON'
+---
+## What
+`SKILLS_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 swift test --filter HotReloadLiveTests` fails on `main` (HEAD 38b5754 and later) at `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/HotReloadLiveTests.swift:66` with `Caught error: Encountered content that cannot be completed into valid JSON`. The failure is the same on two runs. The default `swift test` skips this test, so CI does not see it.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `SKILLS_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 swift test --filter HotReloadLiveTests` — exit 0
+- [ ] The cause of the invalid JSON from the on-device model is found and fixed (or the test is made robust against it)
\ No newline at end of file
